items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Que said he got too much honor himself, he can't go.

ctx.x: Yeah. Que said he got too much honor himself, he can't go. I said, he only had six people and he's making double the money. They were going to give him a whole lot of money up in Chicago and no, Johnny went back to Duke. I said, well, that's the end of that.
Then we went down to on 46th Street, I had Oscar Pettiford.
